test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

After the floods, Uttarakhand was in a _______ (ravaged) condition.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **restored**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ravaged"** means severely damaged or devastated. (तहस-नहस)
 
 
• **Example: **The town was ravaged by the hurricane, leaving many homes in ruins.
 
 
 
• **"Restored"** means to bring back to a former or original condition. (बहाल)
 
 
• **Example: **The old building was restored to its original beauty after years of neglect.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ravaged'** is **'restored'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **restored**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ratified** (अनुमोदित): To approve or confirm formally.
 
 
• **Example:** The treaty was ratified by all member states.
 
 
 
• **Languid** (मंद): Showing or having very little strength, energy, or activity.
 
 
• **Example:** After the long hike, they felt too languid to do anything else.
 
 
 
• **Influenced** (प्रभावित): To have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** His leadership style was greatly influenced by his mentor.
